name: Remote workers and optional browser companion
userOutcome: The user can enroll trusted workers and optionally monitor or control the factory through an authenticated browser interface.
productionDataSource: Worker enrollment, encrypted connections, capabilities, remote events, authenticated sessions, and artifact transfers.
errorBehavior: Fail closed on identity or encryption errors, preserve durable work state, and reconcile remote tasks after reconnect.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not bypass local-only policy through remote routing.
Do not expose the control plane to the network by default.
